---
title: "IOTC Statistical Data Reporting: Form 5MB"
---

## Description

This form provides for the reporting of morphometric measurements and biological sample information for any species caught in association with IOTC fisheries.

Click [here](./Form-5MB.xlsx) to download a blank version of Form 5MB, or [return](./index.html) to the list of all IOTC statistical data reporting forms.

## Metadata

### Submission Information

| Element | Requirement | Description | Format | Example value |
| :--------| :----: | :----------------------- | :-------- | :------------ |
| Liaison officer full name | M | Name of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `John Doe` |
| Liaison officer email	| M | Email address of the liaison officer in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `John.Doe@fao.org` |
| Organisation name | M | Name of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | String | `Institute of Fisheries` |
| Organisation email | O | Email address of the organisation in charge of the compilation of the data | Valid email address | `nif@gov.sc` |
| Finalisation date | M | Date of finalisation of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1996-03-27` |
| Submission date | M | Date of submission of the dataset | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) | `1997-03-21` |

### General Information

| Element | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| Reporting year | Gregorian calendar year of the fishing activities reported through the dataset | 4-digit integer	 | `1996` | 
| Reporting entity | Three-letter (alpha-3) code of the entity reporting the dataset to the IOTC Secretariat | **Code** from [Entities](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#entities) | `EUR` | 
| Flag state | Country in which a fishing vessel is registered and whose flag it is entitled to fly | **Code** from [Countries](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#countries) | `FRA` |

## Morphometric Data

| Element | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| SpecimenID | The unique identifier for the sampled fish specimen | String | `IFRFRI000142` |
| Date start | The earliest date on which the fish could have been caught (start of the sampling period) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DD] | `2025-01-01` |
| Date end | The latest date on which the fish could have been caught (end of the sampling period) | [ISO 8601](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601) [YYYY-MM-DD] | `2025-01-03` | 
| Area | The area of origin of the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Areas](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/admin/index.html#IOTCgridsCESFAR) | `6100050` |
| Gear group | The group of fishing gears that caught the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Gear groups](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/fisheries/index.html#gearGroups) | `PL` |
| Species | The species of the sampled specimen | **Code** from [Species](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#allSpecies) | `FRI` |
| Sex | The sex of the sampled fish specimen | **Code** from [Sex](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#sex) | `F` |
| Status | The preservation or processing condition of the sampled fish | **Code** from [Fish status](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#Fish_Status) | `DEF` |
| Maturity | The reproductive stage of the fish determined by visual inspection of the gonads without a microscope | **Code** from [Maturity Stages](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#maturityStages) | `DEV` |
| Measurement | The morphometric measurement taken | **Code** from [Measurements](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#Measurements) | `FL` | 
| Measurement tool | The tool used to take the morphometric measurement | **Code** from [Measurement tools](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#Measurement_Tools) | `CA` | 
| Value | The morphometric measurement expressed in the appropriate standard unit, i.e., centimetres (cm) for lengths and kilogrammes (kg) for weights | Numeric with one decimal place | `35.5` |

## Sample Data

| Element | Description | Format | Example value |
|:------- |:-----------------------|:-------------:|:-------------:|
| SampleID | Unique identifier for the sample | String | `LIV0018` | 
| Materials | The type of biological materials collected | **Code** from [Biological Materials](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#biologicalMaterials) | `LI` | 
| Protocol | The reference to the sampling protocol used | String (free entry text) | [protocols.io](https://www.protocols.io/view/c-elegans-worm-size-measurement-e6nvwke4wvmk/v1) | 
| Preservation | The type of preservation of the sample | **Code** from [preservation type](https://data.iotc.org/reference/latest/domain/biology/index.html#samplePreservationMethods) | `FR80` |
| Location | The location of the sample | String (free entry text) | `Ifremer Freezer in room A5` | 

## Reporting Deadlines

Submission of Form 5MB is voluntary, and no specific reporting deadline applies. CPCs are encouraged to submit available morphometric and biological data and provide updates as new data become available.
